# ConfirmButton

A two-step destructive button: the first press widens it into a question ("Remove item?") with a draining timer, the second confirms.

`IK.ConfirmButton` · Cart & checkout

## Use

```jsx
<IK.ConfirmButton />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="IK.ConfirmButton"></x-import>
```

## Props (ConfirmButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `confirmLabel` | `string` |  |
| `hint` | `string` | Announced to screen readers when armed. |
| `onConfirm` | `() => void` |  |
| `timeout` | `number` | ms before an unconfirmed press resets. Default 3000. |
